def_en: 1) to be left over, remain, remain over, leave
1b) (Niphal) to be left over, remain over, be left behind
1c4) to show excess, have more than enough, have an excess
kjv: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.
expl: to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve
